ask.title: Тілді таңдаңыз · Выберите язык · Choose your language
ask.note: You can change the language at any time with the picker in the header.

shell.searchPlaceholder: What do you need? Cement, for example

staffBanner.title: Your own account, opened for a check
staffBanner.note: Requests sent from here are marked as test ones and are left out of channel metrics

shell.activationBanner: The account is not open yet. Ask your supplier for an activation link and open it — the catalogue and requests will appear right after that.

noAccess.title: Access is not open
noAccess.note: You are signed in, but the supplier has not opened the account for you yet. If you have an invitation link, activate it; if you already did — write to the supplier.

callbackFailed.title: Sign-in did not finish
callbackFailed.note: The return link has already been used or has expired. Try signing in again.

profile.title: Suppliers
profile.empty: None so far: the account is opened by a supplier — ask them for an invitation link.

consents.title: Personal data consents
consents.empty: No consents yet: they are given by whoever signs in through a supplier's invitation.
consents.failed: Could not get the document. Please try again.

reasons.RENEGOTIATION: The seller changed the request — see what is different
reasons.DEADLINE_SOON: The request is waiting for your answer, the deadline is near
reasons.ACCEPTED: The request has been accepted by the seller
reasons.ORDER_ANSWERED: The seller replied about the request
reasons.fallback: There is news about the request

incomplete.title: The link is incomplete
incomplete.note: The link has no invitation code. Open it in full, exactly as the supplier sent it.

activation.title: Sign in to the account
activation.note: A supplier has invited you: the account holds their catalogue with prices and takes your requests. The invitation is single-use and valid for a limited time.
activation.signInFirst: If you already have a cabinet, sign in — the invitation will be accepted from your account.
activation.signedInAs: The invitation must be issued for this number.
activation.consentAccept: I have read the notice and agree to the processing of my data
activation.passwordNote: You will sign in with it. Your phone number is already known — the supplier provided it.
activation.alreadyHaveAccount: This link did not open the cabinet. If you already had one, sign in and open the link again.
activation.passwordRequired: Choose a password — without it there is no way to sign in.
activation.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Please wait and try again later.
activation.unavailable: The service is unavailable right now. The link is still valid — try again later.

cart.empty: The basket is empty. Pick items in the catalogue.
cart.panelEmpty: Empty so far. Add items from the catalogue — the total will be counted here.
cart.chooseReplacement: Pick a replacement in the catalogue.
cart.priceChanged: The price has changed: was {{was}}, now {{now}}

checkout.title: Checkout

sent.title: The request has been sent
sent.note: The supplier will check stock and prices and come back with an answer. While the check is under way the request is already with them — there is no need to repeat it.

changed.title: The contents have changed
changed.note: Check the prices and stock: the request is not sent until you accept the changes.

checkout.commentPlaceholder: For example: unload at the second entrance, call an hour ahead

summary.title: Summary
summary.shippingNote: The supplier will add the delivery cost during the check.

checkout.note: The supplier will check stock and confirm. If the contents change, you will see a new revision and confirm it yourself.

delivery.pickupOnly: The supplier hands the order over for pickup only.
delivery.addressHint: You have given this address to another supplier
delivery.costLater: The supplier will name the delivery cost when checking the request.
delivery.costByZone: The cost depends on the direction: choose a zone.

favorites.title: Favourites
favorites.empty: Empty so far. Mark items with a heart in the catalogue — they will gather here, and a repeat purchase will not have to be searched for again.
favorites.notAll: Not everything was added to the request
favorites.addAvailable: Add what is available to the request

catalog.searchPlaceholder: What do you need? Cement, for example
catalog.nothingFound: Nothing found. Try another word or pick a category.
catalog.title: Catalogue
catalog.gone: The item does not open. The supplier may have withdrawn it from sale.

orders.title: My requests
orders.empty: No requests yet. Fill the basket in the catalogue and send it.
orders.changesNote: Look at what has changed and answer: confirmation applies to the offered contents.
orders.answerSent: The answer has been sent to the supplier.
orders.agreeAria: I agree with the changes in the request of {{day}}

templates.title: Templates
templates.empty: No templates yet. Fill the basket and save it under a name.
templates.name: Name
templates.namePlaceholder: For example: the site on Abay

questions.title: Questions to seller
questions.subtitle: Correspondence about goods, dates and delivery
questions.empty: Here you ask the seller about goods, dates and delivery, and they answer. The thread is kept apart from requests: a question orders nothing.
questions.question: Question
questions.questionPlaceholder: What would you like to ask the seller?
questions.sent: The question has been sent to the seller.
questions.answerWhere: The answer will arrive in the “Questions to seller” section.
questions.failed: The question was not sent. Try again.
questions.messageFailed: The message was not sent. Try again.
questions.aboutItem: What would you like to know about “{{name}}”?

reviews.title: My reviews
reviews.subtitle: What you have written about the supplier's goods
reviews.empty: You have not rated this supplier's goods yet. You can review what you bought from them — from the item card or from here.
reviews.gone: The item has been withdrawn from sale
reviews.editNote: An edited review goes back to the seller for a check.
reviews.deleteFailed: The review was not deleted. Try again.
reviews.afterCheck: The review will appear in the catalogue after the seller's check.
reviews.textPlaceholder: What you liked and what you did not
reviews.sendFailed: The review was not sent. Try again.
reviews.canReview: You can review what you bought from this supplier.
reviews.noneYet: No reviews yet. Yours will be the first.

delivery.title: Delivery and pickup
delivery.pickupOnly: The seller does not deliver: pickup only
delivery.noPoints: The supplier has not listed pickup points yet — ask them in the “Questions to seller” section.
delivery.note: The terms are set by the seller and may change. The cost for your request is calculated at checkout.
delivery.priceLater: the seller will name the price when confirming the request
